_meta.about: Minimum notice periods from state law. The page shows a timing line ONLY for entries whose state is 'vouched': a person has read the statute text on app.leg.wa.gov and Kate has approved the wording. 'proposed' entries never render.

bodies: county planning commission hearings under the Planning Enabling Act

minimum.text: one publication in a newspaper of general circulation at least ten days before the hearing

statutes.note: Applicability to the Klickitat Energy Overlay Zone amendment not yet confirmed; the county may notice under its own code.
